title: The Question Nobody Could Vote On
title_ja: 投票できなかった問い
fact_notes: オリジナル論説・架空例。実在の調査結果・医学的助言・法令・教授法の実証効果ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: The members of a fictional youth council are asked to choose how a small community fund should be spent during the following year.
sentences.ja: 架空の青少年議会の委員は翌年小規模地域基金をどう使うか選ぶよう求められる。

sentences.en: The chairperson prepares a ballot containing two proposals, one to improve a sports facility and another to purchase books for a public reading room.
sentences.ja: 議長はスポーツ施設改善と公共読書室の本購入という二案を含む投票用紙を用意する。

sentences.en: Members spend considerable time discussing the advantages and limitations of these alternatives before the scheduled vote.
sentences.ja: 委員は予定投票前に両案の利点と限界をかなりの時間議論する。

sentences.en: During the discussion, however, a participant asks why neither proposal includes improving access to facilities that already exist.
sentences.ja: しかし議論中、一参加者は既存施設へのアクセス改善がどちらにも含まれない理由を尋ねる。

sentences.en: Several members explain that transportation difficulties prevent some young people from visiting either facility regularly.
sentences.ja: 交通上の困難で一部青少年がどちらの施設も定期的に訪ねられないと数人が説明する。

sentences.en: The original proposals assumed that the primary problem was a lack of desirable resources rather than limited opportunities to use those resources.
sentences.ja: 元の案は主問題を資源の利用機会の制限でなく望ましい資源の不足と想定していた。

sentences.en: The chairperson recognizes that the available alternatives reflect a particular understanding of the community's needs.
sentences.ja: 利用可能な選択肢が地域の必要についての特定理解を反映すると議長は認識する。

sentences.en: A vote can reveal which of the listed proposals receives more support, but it cannot show how much support an excluded alternative would have received.
sentences.ja: 投票は列挙案のどちらがより支持を得るか示せるが除外された案がどれほど支持されたか示せない。

sentences.en: The council consequently discusses how new proposals might be introduced without making the selection process impossible to complete within the available time.
sentences.ja: そこで利用可能時間内に選考を完了できなくせず新提案をどう導入するか議論する。

sentences.en: Members agree to establish a period for submitting alternative ideas before the final ballot is prepared.
sentences.ja: 最終投票用紙が用意される前に代替案を提出する期間を設けることに同意する。

sentences.en: They also decide that proposals should include an explanation of the problem they are intended to address and a preliminary description of the resources they would require.
sentences.ja: 提案には対応したい問題の説明と必要資源の予備説明を含めるべきだと決める。

sentences.en: These requirements are intended to support useful discussion rather than guarantee that every proposed activity will become an option in the final vote.
sentences.ja: 要件は全提案活動が最終投票の選択肢になる保証でなく有益な議論を支える目的だ。

sentences.en: The imaginary council considers several arrangements for deciding which proposals are eligible for further consideration.
sentences.ja: 架空議会はどの案が追加検討の資格を得るか決める複数の仕組みを考える。

sentences.en: It recognizes that practical limitations may justify excluding some ideas, provided that participants can understand the reasons for doing so.
sentences.ja: 参加者が理由を理解できるなら実務的限界によって一部案の除外を正当化できる場合があると認識する。

sentences.en: The exercise does not prescribe a voting procedure for any real public institution or establish the requirements of an actual law.
sentences.ja: 練習は実在公共機関の投票手順を規定せず実法令の要件も確定しない。

sentences.en: It illustrates instead a distinction between participating in a decision and participating in the process that defines the available alternatives.
sentences.ja: 代わりに判断への参加と利用可能選択肢を定義する過程への参加の区別を示す。

sentences.en: A decision can be made through a clear vote while still reflecting assumptions that were never discussed by the people who cast their ballots.
sentences.ja: 明確な投票で判断がなされても投票者が議論しなかった前提を反映していることがあり得る。

sentences.en: Meaningful participation therefore involves attention to the questions that people are invited to consider as well as the procedures used to record their answers.
sentences.ja: 意味ある参加には回答を記録する手順だけでなく考察を求められる問いへの注意も伴う。

sentences.en: This does not mean that every imaginable alternative must be included in every decision.
sentences.ja: 全ての想像可能な選択肢を全判断に含めるべきという意味ではない。

sentences.en: It means that the reasons for defining the available choices can themselves become an important subject of discussion.
sentences.ja: 選択肢を定義する理由自体が重要な議論対象になり得るという意味だ。

vocabulary.definition: money set aside for a purpose
form used to cast a vote
ability to reach or use something
put forward or brought into use
set up or show to be true

questions.prompt: What were the original two proposals?
options: Offer free transportation or close the reading room.
Raise taxes or reduce every service.
Improve sports facilities or buy books.

questions.prompt: What does the participant's question challenge?
options: The right of all members to speak.
The existence of a community fund.
The limited range of issues presented by the proposals.
The need to complete the vote.

questions.prompt: What difficulty affects some young people?
options: A lack of permission to read books.
The absence of every sports facility.

questions.prompt: Why cannot an ordinary vote reveal support for an excluded idea?
options: Every voter secretly rejects the proposals.
Voters can choose only from the listed alternatives.
The ballot contains every imaginable option.
All voting results are impossible to interpret.
questions.explanation_ja: 投票用紙にない選択肢は測れない。

questions.prompt: What process do members agree to establish?
options: A period for submitting alternative proposals.
A permanent ban on new proposals.
A requirement that all proposals be adopted.

questions.prompt: Why require a description of necessary resources?
options: To ensure that every idea costs the same amount.
To guarantee that no decision can be made.
To support informed discussion of proposals.

questions.prompt: When might exclusion of an idea be justified?
options: Only when all funding is removed.
When practical limitations support it and reasons are understandable.
Whenever the idea has majority support.

questions.prompt: What distinction does the exercise illustrate?
options: Participation in the vote versus participation in defining choices.

questions.prompt: What does cast mean in cast their ballots?

options: Meaningful participation includes examining how the choices for a decision are defined.
Every decision must contain all possible alternatives.
A vote always captures all community preferences.
Members should never question the ballot.
questions.explanation_ja: 判断範囲の形成も重要。

grammar.focus: why neither proposal includes improving access
grammar.explanation_ja: why節がasksの内容、neitherは両方否定。

grammar.focus: how much support an excluded alternative would have received
without making the selection process impossible

paraphrases.source: During the discussion, however, a participant asks why neither proposal includes improving access to facilities that already exist.
paraphrases.rewrite: The participant asks why both proposals omit better access to existing facilities.

paraphrases.source: A vote can reveal which of the listed proposals receives more support, but it cannot show how much support an excluded alternative would have received.
paraphrases.rewrite: A vote cannot measure support for an idea not included on the ballot.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 除外案の支持は分からない。

paraphrases.source: The council consequently discusses how new proposals might be introduced without making the selection process impossible to complete within the available time.
paraphrases.rewrite: They discuss adding ideas without preventing timely completion of the decision.

paraphrases.source: It recognizes that practical limitations may justify excluding some ideas, provided that participants can understand the reasons for doing so.
paraphrases.rewrite: Some exclusions may be reasonable if their reasons are clear to participants.

discourse.role_ja: 実際の法規則でなく概念を説明。
